args.title: Fix issue 4410 in src/config.ts
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

The file src/config.ts reads TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES and RESET_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES environment variables with an int() function that only parses integers with Number.parseInt. This causes values like '12h' or '1h' to be partly parsed as 12 and 1 respectively, silently ignoring the suffix and leading to short token lifetimes. The fix is to validate and reject non-integer string values in this function or when reading these environment variables.

args.title: Fix issue 4423 in src/i18n/index.ts
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

The function pickLocale in src/i18n/index.ts reads the Accept-Language header but ignores the quality values (q=) by only splitting on commas and taking the first two letters of each language. It returns the first supported language ignoring q weights, causing incorrect language selection. It should be changed to correctly parse and respect the quality values to pick the highest weighted supported locale.
